title: Mem2A question
description: A question memory asks back before it can prepare a dossier. Sent by memory as a data part (mediaType `application/vnd.mem2a.question+json`) in a status message with phase `question`.

text.description: The question in plain language, for example `Is the new date funded?`

options.description: Optional: suggested answers. The agent may answer with any text.

expiresAt.description: When memory may stop waiting for an answer and cancel the task. Present whenever memory declares a `watchTimeout`.
